product: Charging Case (USB-C) for AirPods 4 and Wireless Charging Case (USB-C) for AirPods 4 (ANC)

notes.1: accessories intruding into shaded regions will negatively affect product performance
notes.2: do not obstruct this area with metal or other conductive material
notes.3: minimize material thickness for Qi charging performance

notes.5: protective cases may detune or impact RF and wireless charging | avoid metal
notes.6: cases may impact pairing and factory reset on the charging case for AirPods 4
notes.7: cases may impact pairing, factory reset and serial number lookup on the wireless charging case for AirPods 4 (ANC)
notes.8: only applicable to the wireless charging case for AirPods 4 (ANC)
